svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blade: UHMW-PE 15 mm sheet, 3,000 long x 300 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the two top corners R20. Keep the bottom edge straight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and square: it is the gathering edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes match the beam: 11 mm, countersunk on the front face so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M10 countersunk heads sit 1 mm below the surface.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ten blade bolt holes 100 mm above the bottom edge, 150 to 1,350

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the middle, 300 apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six skid hanger bolt holes 75 and 125 mm above the bottom edge at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill with a sharp wood bit; clear the swarf; no heat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the back face sits flat on the beam's front face; the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge 50 mm below the beam, 10 mm above the floor in use.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bottom edge is straight within 3 mm along its length.
